purpose: Machine-readable additions discovered after frozen function-level closure snapshots without rewriting those historical closure counts.

additions.evaluated_object: First-party AHO optimizer plus persistent evolving harness state, with the inner task-solving model fixed while system-prompt and tool-boundary middleware changes are selected using repair/holdout evidence and evaluated on later held-out cases.
additions.non_claim: Direct S4 fit belongs to the external AHO optimizer plus evolving-harness boundary. The fixed inner model, outer proposer, BFCL or tau2 benchmark do not inherit S4 ownership, and this single non-canonical study does not select an S4 primary baseline.
